transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I guess I'm here because I just feel like I'm always running hot. It's like I can't ever shut the motor off... and lately, that's been getting me into some trouble at the firehouse.
Would you say this feeling of always 'running hot' is something you've experienced your whole life, or is it a change from how you used to feel and function before?

No, it's pretty much been my whole life. It's definitely not a new thing. My mom says I was exactly like this way back in grade school, too. I was always the kid getting up out of my seat, blurting out answers in class... losing my homework constantly. She used to get notes sent home from my teachers all the time about it, which was frustrating for her because they always said I was bright enough to do the work. I just never could seem to settle down.
Do you notice a pattern of intense, up-and-down relationships in your life, where you swing between idealizing someone and then feeling very angry or disappointed in them?

No, I wouldn't say that. My relationships are pretty steady, honestly. I mean, my wife gets frustrated with me sometimes because I forget things or I'm always moving around, but we don't have those big swings you're talking about. We've been together a long time and it's pretty stable. I don't really have that issue with friends or the guys at the station, either.
